title: EAOS public monorepo
description: Plugin and application authors use EAOS to compose authorized features across server and browser hosts.

title: CLI authoring and release tools
description: Plugin and host developers use the CLI to generate, diagnose and verify EAOS packages.

title: Core contracts and plugin SDK
description: Plugin authors use Core to declare portable features, data ownership and entitlement contracts.

title: React workspaces and browser clients
description: Application authors use React workspaces and portable clients to bind authenticated product UI.

title: Server execution and persistence
description: Host developers use Server to compose HTTP/MCP, lifecycle and durable data services.

title: Standard plugin collection
description: EAOS host developers use this MIT collection to add approval, field customization and administration through explicitly selected feature modules.

title: @alneas/eaos-plugins/admin
description: Administrators use the generic admin plugin to inspect explicitly exposed resources and audit history.

title: @alneas/eaos-plugins/approval
description: Teams use the generic approval plugin to request and record explicit review decisions.

title: @alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization
description: Administrators use the generic field-customization plugin to configure permitted field presentation.
